name: mindsparker_damages_only_the_caster
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: '... this creature deals 2 damage to that player.' Three players; seat 0 controls Mindsparker. Seat 2 casts Opt (a blue instant): 'that player' is the caster, so seat 2 takes 2 and seat 1, the other opponent, takes nothing (not each opponent, not a target).
